newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom seeks quick price formula.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom seeks quick price formula.

text.p: The new pricing formula for Portugal Telecom (PT) phone charges needs to be ready before the next phase of its privatisation, set for late summer, chairman Francisco Murteira Nabo said.
The formula, which would need to be more competitive and aggressive than past conventions, would cover price changes for 1998-2000, he said.
The formula for the present year, which is set by the government, is the consumer price index (CPI) less three percentage points.
Nabo, who was presenting the company's results, also said that Portugal Telecom expected its cable television operation, TV Cabo, to break even in 1999. It lost 3.9 billion escudos in 1996.
